overview: This House resolution expresses the House's deep sorrow at the death of Representative Gerald E. Connolly of Virginia, who served in the House. It directs the Clerk of the House to send the resolution to the Senate and a copy to Representative Connolly's family. It also provides that the House adjourn that day as a further sign of respect for him. The House adopted it on May 22, 2025.
for: Supporters say it continues the House's tradition of formally honoring a member who died in office.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
